description: This plot illustrates the relationship between Loss and TFLOPs for two different configurations, one labeled "Vanilla" and another with an obscured label in the legend. The x-axis represents TFLOPs on a linear scale, ranging from 0.00 to 1.25 with a multiplier of 1e9 applied to the axis values, featuring tick marks at regular intervals of 0.25. The y-axis represents Loss on a linear scale, ranging from 2.40 to 2.75 with tick marks at intervals of 0.05. The "Vanilla" configuration is depicted by a solid purple line with upward-pointing triangle markers. It exhibits a steady decline across the x-axis, starting from a visible value of approximately 2.69 at 0.13e9 TFLOPs and ending at exactly 2.50 at 1.20e9 TFLOPs. The second configuration is represented by a solid red line with circular markers. It also demonstrates a declining trend, starting from a visible value of roughly 2.74 at 0.08e9 TFLOPs, dropping steeply to 2.64 at 0.14e9 TFLOPs, and concluding at approximately 2.47 at 1.20e9 TFLOPs. Additionally, the plot includes green dashed annotations: a horizontal line at a Loss of 2.50, and two vertical lines dropping from the points where the red and purple lines intersect this 2.50 Loss threshold (at approximately 0.94e9 and 1.20e9 TFLOPs, respectively). These intersection points are marked with green stars, and a green double-headed arrow labeled "1.28×" spans the horizontal distance between the two vertical dashed lines.
